lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the torso, with relatively uniform spacing of approximately 15-20 pixels between segments in the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed at the dorsal terminus of the 8th vertical line (counting from anterior to posterior) where the segment splits into a narrow Y-shape.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 9, 10, and 11 exhibit significant discontinuities, manifesting as dashed vertical alignments that do not reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-density cluster of 4 distinct circular white spots located on the lower posterior haunch, superior to the hind-leg joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb show a horizontal geometric alignment parallel to the spinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Darkened 'sock' pigmentation on distal limbs starting approximately mid-metatarsal/metacarpal extending to the hooves; white interior ear fringe contrast.
